project_type: Full-stack web application - React SPA frontend with Node.js/Express backend and PostgreSQL database
build_system: Vite for frontend, tsx/ts-node for backend, npm workspaces for monorepo structure
test_framework: Vitest for frontend unit tests, Vitest for backend unit/integration tests
build_command: npm run build (runs both frontend and backend builds)
test_command: npm test (runs all tests across workspaces)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install at root. 2. Run npm run build to compile both packages. 3. Run npm test to execute all tests. 4. Start dev servers and verify login flow, subject creation, grade management.
setup_instructions: 1. npm install at project root. 2. Set up PostgreSQL database (or use Docker compose). 3. Copy .env.example to .env and configure DB connection. 4. Run database migrations. 5. npm run dev to start both frontend and backend in development mode.
environment_constraints: Network available for npm installs. PostgreSQL needed for persistent storage. Docker available for containerized database.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - establishing conventions from scratch.
key_patterns: Monorepo with packages/frontend and packages/backend. REST API with JWT authentication. React with React Router for SPA navigation. Tailwind CSS with custom theme for pastel pink/purple palette. Dark/light mode via Tailwind dark class strategy.
directory_structure: Monorepo structure: packages/frontend (React + Vite + Tailwind), packages/backend (Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL). Shared types in packages/shared.
